issues.explanation: The watch record leaves Vela's companion unnamed, so it cannot establish that Sora accompanied her.

evidence.excerpt: At 19点 Vela moved from Gate Four on the west pier to the east pier; the watch record leaves her companion unnamed.

issues.reasoning: The cited watch record says that at 19点 Vela moved from Gate Four on the west pier to the east pier and that the record leaves her companion unnamed. The draft converts that unnamed companion into an attributed fact that the record establishes Sora. The missing link is the identity of the companion; the record does not say Sora, so the attribution is unsupported. It does not follow that Sora was not there, only that the cited record does not establish it.
